title: stachys palustris var. cordata
intro: Stachys palustris var. cordata, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia, characterized by its tall spikes of blue flowers and heart-shaped leaves. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing fever, relieving headaches, and soothing digestive issues. Wood Betony's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
